verdict.rationale: jo runs on its own always-available cloud machine and can work in the background overnight, and it accepts scheduled jobs such as weekly plans or morning priorities. That covers autonomous background work, but the documented examples are mostly recurring briefing-style jobs, not a one-off multi-step task delegated ad hoc. Missing for 10: an explicit one-off delegation of an arbitrary multi-step task, a documented hand-back or review step for task results, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can delegate a multi-step task that the assistant works on autonomously in the background and returns for my review

citations.quote: because jo has its own machine, it can work overnight: read what came in, watch what changed, and prepare your morning before you wake.
Give jo a job and a schedule. Get a weekly plan, morning priorities, or a weekend task review without asking each time.
It lets jo keep working across devices without putting everyone into one shared database.
